A router. My friends think I'm nuts, but most hotel WiFi is not only poor quality, but terribly insecure. There's often a wired option and I have the router configured to automatically connect to VPN. I get a solid connection with no packet shaping, spam or security problems.

I'm a geek, so usually have a couple spare routers laying around, but if you don't, it's $100 you'll never regret. Especially important if you travel to places where privacy and freedom of speech are less valued. Upgrade your router to DD-WRT or similar for best results.
